page_title: GEN 3-0 CAG | Genoa v Cagliari 12/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) steps up to take the free kick, but his attempt to threaten the goal is unsuccessful as the ball flies way past the right post.
89' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Patrizio Masini (Genoa). Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
86' Some neat passing and movement from Cagliari as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
84' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
81' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Vitinha and he is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is replacing Mikael Egill Ellertsson.
80' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Genoa players have a reason to celebrate!
80' The Genoa players halt their celebrations as referee Federico La Penna makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

78' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Aaron Martin sends a cross in from the set piece and Leo Ostigard (Genoa) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes inside the left post and the score changes to 3:0.

75' 2 - 0 Morten Frendrup (Genoa) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0 with this magnificent strike.
75' A cross into the box from Vitinha (Genoa) is cleared.
74' That's the end of the game for Lorenzo Colombo, who is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
74' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
73' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:3.
71' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.

70' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the bottom right corner, but Nicola Leali has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
69' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) replacing Luca Mazzitelli.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sebastiano Esposito as he is replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
68' Aaron Martin (Genoa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
65' Some great controlled play and passing from Genoa. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Aaron Martin (Genoa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
62' It's time for a substitution. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) comes on in place of Zito Luvumbo.
59' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) blasts the ball from a direct free kick towards the net. His tame low drive flies to the middle of the goal, directly into the goalkeeper’s gloves.
58' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Michel Adopo (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.

58' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Elia Caprile pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
56' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
54' The game has begun to heat up. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
52' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

49' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Elia Caprile pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.

49' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Federico La Penna no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
48' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) gets the ball from a rebound before trying his luck with a good long-range shot which threatens the goalkeeper! The ball sails just over the crossbar!
48' An attempted cross from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is cleared.
46' Half-time substitution. Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) will not participate anymore and Riyad Idrissi is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Daniele De Rossi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa). He is replaced by Patrizio Masini.
46' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Some patient build-up play from Genoa as they look to unlock the defence.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adam Obert (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) hits a dangerous effort towards the top left corner from the promising free kick. His shot is stopped by a well prepared Nicola Leali. Cagliari win a corner.
39' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
37' Adam Obert (Cagliari) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' None of the Cagliari players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
35' Adam Obert (Cagliari) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
34' Close! Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
34' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
33' 41:59 – the latest ball possession ratio.
32' Genoa fail to score from a corner as Elia Caprile (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.

31' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the top of the net, Elia Caprile makes a decent save to stop the effort. Genoa earn a corner.
30' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
29' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) gets to the rebound and from mid-range takes a shot which crashes against the crossbar!
28' Cagliari couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Nicola Leali (Genoa) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
28' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Cagliari will take a free kick.
27' Cagliari are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
26' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
25' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for an infringement.
23' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
22' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

21' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Michel Adopo (Cagliari) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
21' A lofted cross from Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

19' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
17' Cagliari keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
15' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
13' Vitinha (Genoa) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
11' Vitinha (Genoa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
10' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

7' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Ruslan Malinovskyi slips the ball through to Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
5' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
4' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
3' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
3' Genoa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
2' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Genoa have a corner.
1' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna will referee today's match.
